        (29, 49), (34, 54), (24, 54), (29, 59)
    ]

        for tx, ty in target_blocks:
            if tx <= x < tx + 3 and ty <= y < ty + 3:

                        cx, cy = tx + dx, ty + dy

                                new_grid[cy][cx] = 14  # e
                            elif new_grid[cy][cx] == 14:
                                new_grid[cy][cx] = 0
                break
        # Check if click is in the timer area
        if x in timer_cols:

            pass
        # Check if click is in the play area
        elif 12 <= x < 57 and 17 <= y < 23:
